item.title: WOMEN’S CHRISTMAS BRUNCH AND COOKIE SWAP
item.description: Ladies, mark your calendars! We would love to celebrate Christmas together with you. You are invited to the Life in the Son Women’s Christmas Brunch and Cookie Swap on Saturday, December 12th, starting at 10:00 AM right here in the Main Auditorium. Between the holiday rush and busy schedules, this is a special morning to pause, put on your favorite festive attire, lift our voices together in worship, and share real connection across all ages and seasons of life. item.title: New Visitors' Lunch
item.description: NEW TO LIFE IN THE SON If you are new to Life in the Son, join us for lunch to meet some of the Life in the Son team, learn more about the church, and ask any questions you have. The lunch reception will be on October 25 at 10:45 AM in the Life Cafe. Those attending the 2nd service are welcome to come earlier to join the lunch reception. We look forward to meeting you.
